name: selena
description: Selena finds unmet demand and understands it well enough to be built. Headless core; the HUD, the scheduler and Jason's endpoint are all callers of the same pipeline.

comments.no-npx: Every script is `node <path>`, never a bare CLI name: .cmd/.bat shims are blocked by group policy on the target machine.
comments.lazy-genai: core/llm.js imports @google/genai dynamically, so the core, the tests and the stress suite all run with no node_modules at all. A test that needs a network SDK installed is a test that stops being run.
comments.no-router-dep: The HUD routes on window.location.hash in ~40 lines. A router dependency for eight pages is weight with no payoff.
